content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":168,"severity":"major","message":"The change from `lastIndex` to `1` in `urlObject.pathname.slice(1, protocolAtIndex)` breaks the duplicate-slash removal logic for pathnames containing protocol-like patterns (e.g., 'http://'). The `lastIndex` variable tracks the end of the previous protocol match so each segment between protocols is processed exactly once. Using `1` causes: (1) the first character (typically '/') to be dropped from the first segment, (2) overlapping/repeated processing of earlier segments on subsequent iterations, and (3) `lastIndex` to be updated but never used, making the loop logic incorrect."}]}
